fee_notes: Royalty minimum tiered: $1,000/mo (months 13–24), $1,500 (25–36), $2,000 (37–48), $2,500 (49–60), $3,000 (61+). Sales Center: 6% of Gross Sales, min $1,000/mo (month 13+). Digital Marketing Management: $1,000/mo (month 7+). Local Advertising Requirement: 5% minimum (recommended 8–13%, spent locally not to franchisor). All recurrent fees collected semi-monthly via EFT.
raw_excerpt: Royalty Fee: 7% of Gross Sales, subject to Minimum Royalty Fee per Territory beginning in month 13. Brand Fund Contribution: 1% of Gross Sales, semi-monthly. Technology Fee: $500 per month. Sales Center Fee: 6% of Gross Sales, subject to minimum of $1,000 per month beginning month 13.
